en.name: Tomato sauce for spaghetti or pizza
en.summary: Commercial tomato sauce in a can or carton is shelf-stable until you open it, and there is no fixed cupboard timeline to quote — go by the package use-by date. Once opened, it is a cooked low-acid food with 3–5 days in the fridge. Refrigerating unopened jars will not lengthen shelf life.
en.pantry: For an unopened can, jar or carton there is no fixed number: the package use-by date is the guide, with the container kept cool, dry and out of the sun. Refrigerating unopened jars will not lengthen shelf life, so the fridge is wasted space until the seal is broken. Discard without opening any can that is bulging, leaking, rusted through or badly dented along a seam, and do not return an opened jar to the cupboard however full it looks.
en.fridge: Once opened, transfer the sauce out of the can into a sealed container, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and use within 3–5 days. That is short because an opened jar of tomato sauce is a cooked, low-acid vegetable dish, much closer to leftover soup than to a condiment. Reheat only the portion you need, to a full rolling boil, rather than warming the whole container and putting it back.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for commercial tomato sauce, but freezing is the practical answer to a container you cannot finish in a few days, and tomato sauce freezes well. Pour the remainder into a flat bag or a rigid container with headspace and freeze at −18 °C (0 °F) on the day you open it. Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; flavour is the limit.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen tomato sauce in the fridge, or tip it straight from frozen into a covered pan over low heat. Bring it to a full boil before serving and never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A bulging can or a domed lid, or spurting and hissing on opening
Mould on the surface or around the rim of the storage container
A fermented, yeasty or fizzy character
A sour smell, or sauce that has darkened and separated in the fridge
tips: Freeze the leftovers on the day you open the container, not later in the week.
Decant out of the can into glass or plastic straight away.
Buy the size that matches the meal; a big tin is no bargain here.
Write the opening date on the container.

faq.q: How long does opened tomato sauce last in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–5 days at 4 °C or below in a sealed container. Once opened it is a cooked low-acid food, not a condiment.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of tomato sauce keep?
faq.a: There is no fixed timeline — go by the package use-by date, stored cool and dry.
No. Refrigerating unopened jars will not lengthen shelf life.

faq.q: Can you freeze leftover tomato sauce?
faq.a: Yes, and it is the practical answer. Freeze it flat at −18 °C on the day you open the container.

zh.name: 番茄醬汁（義大利麵、披薩用）
zh.summary: 市售罐裝或紙盒裝的番茄醬汁在開封前可以常溫保存，而且沒有固定的櫥櫃天數可以引用——請以包裝上的有效日期為準。開封後，它就是一份熟製的低酸性食品，冷藏 3～5 天。未開封的罐子冷藏並不會延長保存期。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭、玻璃罐或紙盒沒有固定數字：請以包裝上的有效日期為準，並存放在陰涼乾燥、避免日曬的地方。未開封的罐子放冷藏並不會延長保存期，所以在封口打開之前，冰箱空間都是浪費。罐身鼓起、滲漏、鏽穿或接縫嚴重凹陷的，不要開，直接丟掉；開過的罐子也不要放回櫥櫃，不管看起來還有多滿。
zh.fridge: 開封後請把醬移出罐頭、裝進密封容器，放 4 °C 以下，並在 3～5 天內用完。這麼短是因為開封後的番茄醬汁其實是一份熟製的低酸性蔬菜料理，比較接近剩下的濃湯而不是調味料。每次只加熱要用的份量並煮到大滾，不要整盒加熱後又放回去。
zh.freezer: 市售番茄醬汁沒有已發表的冷凍期限，但對幾天內用不完的一盒來說，冷凍就是最實際的答案，而番茄醬汁也很適合冷凍。請在開封當天把剩下的裝進平放的密封袋或留膨脹空間的硬質容器，放 −18 °C。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持；限制的是風味。
zh.thawing: 冷凍番茄醬汁請放冷藏解凍，或直接蓋鍋小火從冷凍加熱。上桌前要煮到大滾，也絕對不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起或蓋子鼓起，或開罐時噴出、有嘶聲
醬面或保存容器邊緣長霉
出現發酵味、酵母味或氣泡感
聞起來發酸，或冷藏中的醬明顯變深並分層
tips: 開封當天就把用不完的冷凍起來，不要拖到週末。
開罐後立刻移到玻璃或塑膠容器。
依這一餐的需求選容量；大罐在這裡並不划算。

faq.q: 開封的番茄醬汁放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放 4 °C 以下 3～5 天。開封後它是熟製的低酸性食品，不是調味料。

faq.q: 未開封的番茄醬汁可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有固定天數——以包裝上的有效日期為準，存放在陰涼乾燥處。

faq.q: 未開封的罐子冰起來有幫助嗎？
faq.a: 沒有。未開封的罐子冷藏並不會延長保存期。

faq.q: 用不完的番茄醬汁可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，而且這才是實際的答案。開封當天就平放冷凍在 −18 °C。
